290tommy_inline tommy_hashlin_node** tommy_hashlin_pos(tommy_hashlin* hashlin, tommy_hash_t pos)
291{
292 tommy_uint_t bsr;
293
294 /* get the highest bit set, in case of all 0, return 0 */
295 bsr = tommy_ilog2(pos | 1);
296
297 return &hashlin->bucket[bsr][pos];
298}
299
303tommy_inline tommy_hashlin_node** tommy_hashlin_bucket_ref(tommy_hashlin* hashlin, tommy_hash_t hash)
304{
305 tommy_size_t pos = hash & hashlin->low_mask;
306 tommy_size_t high_pos = hash & hashlin->bucket_mask;
307
308 /* if this position is already allocated in the high half */
309 if (pos < hashlin->split) {
310 /* the following assignment is expected to be implemented */
311 /* with a conditional move instruction */
312 /* that results in a little better and constant performance */
313 /* regardless of the split position. */
314 /* this affects mostly the worst case, when the split value */
315 /* is near at its half, resulting in a totally unpredictable */
316 /* condition by the CPU. */
317 /* in such case, the use of the conditional move is generally faster. */
318
319 /* use also the high bit */
320 pos = high_pos;
321 }
322
323 return tommy_hashlin_pos(hashlin, pos);
324}
325
335tommy_inline tommy_hashlin_node* tommy_hashlin_bucket(tommy_hashlin* hashlin, tommy_hash_t hash)
336{
337 return *tommy_hashlin_bucket_ref(hashlin, hash);
338}

351tommy_inline tommy_hashlin_node* tommy_hashlin_find(tommy_hashlin* hashlin, tommy_search_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg, tommy_hash_t hash)
352{
353 tommy_hashlin_node* i = tommy_hashlin_bucket(hashlin, hash);
354
355 while (i) {
356 /* we first check if the hash matches, as in the same bucket we may have multiple hash values */
357 if (i->index == hash && cmp(cmp_arg, i->data) == 0)
358 return i;
359 i = i->next;
360 }
361 return 0;
362}

375tommy_inline void* tommy_hashlin_search(tommy_hashlin* hashlin, tommy_search_func* cmp, const void* cmp_arg, tommy_hash_t hash)
376{
377 tommy_hashlin_node* node = tommy_hashlin_find(hashlin, cmp, cmp_arg, hash);
378
379 return node ? node->data : 0;
380}
